papers.title: CROP: Token-Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models via Regularized Prompt Optimization
papers.institution_evidence: PDF page1 and HTML author affiliations
papers.dedup_result: Only directory source-history rows existed, no catalog key, code module or individual README before this batch.
papers.algorithm: Algorithm1 and Eqs1-4: target response; training task text critique; strict output-token threshold brevity critique; concatenate task + newline + regularization text; external meta-optimizer rewrites prompt; accuracy minus lambda normalized mean output-token score selects prompt.
papers.cost_basis: Gemini3.1Pro Thinking optimizer, Gemini2Flash dual evaluators, Gemini2Flash and Qwen2.5-7B targets; GSM8K/LogiQA/BBH plus baselines and validation hyperparameter search. T/B and total cost not fully specified, do not assume cheap.

papers.title: CONCUR: Concordant Auxiliary Rewards for Multi-Task, Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
papers.google_priority_basis: Work while interning at Google; Google/Google DeepMind coauthors; do not rewrite first-author institution to Google.
papers.method_checks: Auxiliary group-standardized scores projected to primary partial-order cone. Tie ceiling scores by their mean then PAVA, but equal primary values below ceiling have no artificial equality constraint. No re-standardization after projection. Earned trust uses cumulative per-group agreement mean >2*SE, including current batch; binary primary never earns a reading. Whole-batch whitening follows weighted sum.
papers.cost_basis: AppendixD.2 explicitly 4 nodes x8 NVIDIA RTX PRO6000 =32GPUs per run; 300steps,512prompts,8responses,4K/8K completions; 3base models, multiple estimators and15benchmarks.
papers.code_status: No method-author repository link verified in HTML; OpenR1 and benchmark references are not CONCUR code.

papers.title: Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
papers.google_priority_basis: Coauthor Zhiwei Deng affiliated Google DeepMind; first author remains Princeton.
papers.method_checks: Store segment mean and raw second moment of projected routing keys. Recover q^Tmean and q^TsecondMoment*q-(q^Tmean)^2. Normalize mean and variance scores with separate softmaxes and learned temperatures, then mix by learned scalar gate. Do not replace with a single softmax of summed moments; retain causal visible-segment mask.
papers.cost_basis: GatedDeltaNet1.3B pretraining50B tokens; Mamba2-780M checkpoint pretrained300B tokens; both need 2B-token stage1 and60M-token stage2 at16K context/256-token segments, multiple baselines and long-context benchmarks.
